 16     Combine lines 7 and 15 and enter the result       .     .   .   .   .   .   .   .   .   .   .   .   .   .   .   .   .   .   16

        • If line 16 is a loss, skip lines 17 through 20 below. Then, go to line 21. Also be sure to complete

          1040-NR, line 7a. Then, go to line 22.
